title: REQ · PhaserHost creates one pixel-art Phaser 3.90 game, handles resize and destroys it on unmount
summary: A React PhaserHost owns a single Phaser.Game created with pixel-art settings, refreshed on resize and destroyed on unmount.
description: Context: Phaser is absent from game/frontend. Desired behavior: add phaser ^3.90.0, a createGame factory wrapping new Phaser.Game(config), a config builder with pixelArt, roundPixels, FIT scaling with integer zoom, and a PhaserHost component guarded against StrictMode double-mount. A ResizeObserver on the container refreshes scaling for container size and devicePixelRatio. Expected result: one live game instance, destroyed on unmount. Why: prevents leaked canvases and blurry scaling.
acceptance_criteria: Given PhaserHost mounts in StrictMode, When effects run mount, cleanup, mount, Then at most one game is alive and destroy(true) was called on the first.
Given PhaserHost unmounts, When cleanup runs, Then destroy(true) is called and the ref is null.
Given buildGameConfig is called, When read, Then render.pixelArt and render.roundPixels are true and scale.mode is FIT.
Given a container of 1000x600 at DPR 2, When computeZoom runs with a 640x360 logical size, Then it returns an integer of at least 1.
Given the observed container resizes, When the observer fires, Then game.scale.refresh is called.
definition_of_done: PhaserHost, config and factory exist and typecheck
